description_en: Issues a single client certificate based on a system-generated certificate signing request (CSR)
description_zh: 基于系统自动生成的CSR签发单个客户端证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-client-certificate --san-type 1 --san-value somebody@example.com --organization '阿里云' --organization-unit IT --country CN --common-name aliyun --state Zhejiang --locality '杭州市' --algorithm RSA_2048 --parent-identifier 273ae6bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --years 5 --months 1 --days 365 --before-time 1634283958 --after-time 1665819958 --immediately 1 --enable-crl 1 --tags Value=1 Key=account --resource-group-id rg-aek0000wia --custom-identifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --alias-name cert-name --client-token XXX --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateClientCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The Subject Alternative Name (SAN) type supported by the client certificate. Valid values:

1: email address.
6: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
parameters.help_zh:
客户端证书支持的扩展信息SAN（Subject Alternative Name）类型。取值：

1：表示邮箱。
6：表示统一资源标志符URI（Uniform Resource Identifier）
parameters.name: san_type

parameters.help_en: The specific SAN extension information of the client certificate. You can enter multiple SAN values separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 客户端证书的具体扩展信息。支持输入多个扩展信息，如果您需要输入多个扩展信息，请用半角逗号（,）将其隔开
parameters.name: san_value

parameters.help_en: The organization name. Default value: Alibaba Inc
parameters.help_zh: 机构名称，默认：Alibaba Inc
parameters.name: organization

parameters.help_en: The department name. Default value: Aliyun CDN
parameters.help_zh: 部门名称，默认：Aliyun CDN
parameters.name: organization_unit

parameters.help_en: The country. Default value: CN
parameters.help_zh: 所属国家，默认：CN
parameters.name: country

parameters.help_en: The name of the certificate subject. The subject of a client authentication (ClientAuth) certificate is typically a person, company, organization, or application. Specify the common name of the subject. For example, John Doe, Alibaba, Alibaba Cloud Crypto Platform, or Tmall Genie
parameters.help_zh: 表示证书使用者的名称。客户端认证（ClientAuth）证书使用者一般是自然人、公司、组织或某个应用，建议填写使用者的通用名称。例如，张三、阿里巴巴、阿里云密码平台、天猫精灵等
parameters.name: common_name

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the certificate organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported. Default value: the province, municipality, or autonomous region of the sub-CA certificate that issues this certificate.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the certificate organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported. Default value: the province or state of the sub-CA certificate that issues this certificate.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">设置证书组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。默认为签发该证书的子CA证书组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">设置证书组织机构所在省份或州的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。默认为签发该证书的子CA证书组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The name of the city where the certificate organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported.
Default value: the city of the sub-CA certificate that issues this certificate
parameters.help_zh:
设置证书组织机构所在城市的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。
默认为签发该证书的子CA证书的组织机构所在城市的名称
parameters.name: locality

parameters.help_en:
The key algorithm of the client certificate. The key algorithm is in the format of `<encryption algorithm>_<key length>`. Valid values:

RSA_1024: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
RSA_2048: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
RSA_4096: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
ECC_256: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.
ECC_384: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.
ECC_512: The signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.
SM2_256: The signature algorithm is SM3WithSM2.

The encryption algorithm of the client certificate must be the same as that of the sub-CA certificate, but the key length can be different. For example, if the key algorithm of the sub-CA certificate is RSA_2048, the key algorithm of the client certificate must be RSA_1024, RSA_2048, or RSA_4096.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html to query the key algorithm of the sub-CA certificate
parameters.help_zh:
客户端证书的密钥算法。密钥算法使用`<加密算法>_<密钥长度>`格式表示。取值：

RSA_1024：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
RSA_2048：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
RSA_4096：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
ECC_256：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
ECC_384：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
ECC_512：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
SM2_256：对应签名算法为SM3WithSM2。

客户端证书的加密算法必须与子CA证书一致，密钥长度可以不一致。例如：子CA证书的密钥算法为RSA_2048，则客户端证书的密钥算法必须是RSA_1024、RSA_2048、RSA_4096中的一种。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html查询子CA证书的密钥算法
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the sub-CA certificate that issues this certificate. The Private Certificate Authority instance (PrivateCaInstanceId) bound to the sub-CA must be in a valid and unexpired state.
You can call [DescribeCACertificateList] to query the unique identifier of the sub-CA certificate
parameters.help_zh:
签发该证书的子CA证书的唯一识别码。 Sub CA 所绑定的私有 CA 实例（PrivateCaInstanceId）必须处于有效未过期状态。
您可以调用[DescribeCACertificateList]查询子CA证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: parent_identifier

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: years
parameters.help_zh: 购买证书的时长。单位：年
parameters.name: years

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the certificate. Unit: months
parameters.help_zh: 购买证书的时长。单位：月
parameters.name: months

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the client certificate. Unit: days.
The Days, BeforeTime, and AfterTime parameters cannot all be empty, and the BeforeTime and AfterTime parameters must both be empty or both be specified. The following rules apply:

If you set the Days parameter, you can optionally set both BeforeTime and AfterTime or leave them empty.
If you do not set the Days parameter, you must set both BeforeTime and AfterTime.

If you set Days, BeforeTime, and AfterTime at the same time, the validity period is determined by the Days parameter.
The validity period of the client certificate cannot exceed that of the sub-CA certificate. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html to query the validity period of the sub-CA certificate
parameters.help_zh:
客户端证书的有效期。单位：天。
Days、BeforeTime、AfterTime参数不能同时为空，并且BeforeTime、AfterTime参数必须同时为空或者同时设置。该参数具体设置说明如下：

当设置Days参数时，您可以选择同时设置BeforeTime、AfterTime参数或者不设置BeforeTime、AfterTime参数。
当不设置Days参数时，您必须设置BeforeTime、AfterTime参数。

当您同时设置Days、BeforeTime、AfterTime参数时，客户端证书的有效期以Days参数的值为准。
客户端证书的有效期不能超过子CA证书的有效期。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html查看子CA证书的有效期
parameters.name: days

parameters.help_en:
The issuance time of the client certificate in timestamp format. Default value: the time when you call this operation. Unit: seconds.

The BeforeTime and AfterTime parameters must both be empty or both be specified
parameters.help_zh:
客户端证书的签发时间，使用时间戳格式，默认为您调用该接口的时间。单位：秒。

BeforeTime和AfterTime参数必须同时为空或者同时设置
parameters.name: before_time

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the client certificate in timestamp format. Unit: seconds.
The BeforeTime and AfterTime parameters must both be empty or both be specified
parameters.help_zh:
客户端证书的服务到期时间，使用时间戳格式。单位：秒。
BeforeTime和AfterTime参数必须同时为空或者同时设置
parameters.name: after_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately return the digital certificate. Valid values:
0: Does not return the certificate. This is the default value.
1: Returns the certificate.
2: Returns the certificate and its certificate chain
parameters.help_zh:
立即返回数字证书。
0，不返回。默认值。
1，返回证书。
2， 返回证书及其证书链
parameters.name: immediately

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the Certificate Revocation List (CRL) address. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含CRL地址

0 - 否
1 - 是
parameters.name: enable_crl

parameters.help_en: The tag list
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源分组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The custom identifier, which serves as a unique key
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键
parameters.name: custom_identifier

parameters.help_en: The name of the issued certificate
parameters.help_zh: 设置签发证书的名称
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can contain up to 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The asynchronous processing flag. If the value is set to "true", the backend service issues the certificate asynchronously.
After the request is submitted, you can call the ListClientCertificate operation to obtain the latest certificate
parameters.help_zh:
异步处理标识。当传值为“true”时，后端服务将采用异步的方式申请证书。
用户请求后可通过ListClientCertificate接口获取最新证书
parameters.name: asynchronous_flag

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the client certificate
Identifier.description_zh: 客户端证书的唯一识别码

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used for troubleshooting and diagnostics
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
